value.rationale: An infinite natural family of frustrated spin clusters has graph-independent exact 0, one-third and saturation plateau thresholds. The proof identifies exactly how graph-dependent entropy data are encoded by incidence matchings and constrained orientations, and the truncated-cube example gives a nontrivial complete critical-field degeneracy census. This is structurally motivated, not a parameter substitution or arbitrarily chosen numeric slice.
